extracted.intended_audience: policymakers, BBC staff, regulators, and members of the public interested in BBC governance and duties
extracted.subtask_description: Summary of the BBC Royal Charter and the accompanying Agreement, setting out the BBC's constitutional basis, mission and public purposes, governance/regulatory arrangements, funding duties, and publication obligations for listed public services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Royal Charter sets BBC Object, Mission and Public Purposes
rubrics_metrics.description: The Royal Charter is the constitutional basis for the BBC. It sets out the BBC’s Object, Mission and Public Purposes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Charter defines the core purpose and public remit of the Corporation; these are treated as the constitutional foundation against which the BBC operates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Charter outlines governance and regulatory arrangements
rubrics_metrics.description: The Charter outlines the Corporation’s governance and regulatory arrangements, including the role and composition of the BBC Board.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Governance details such as board role and composition are specified in the Charter and form the basis for how the BBC is overseen and regulated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Charter term and effective dates
rubrics_metrics.description: The current Charter began on 1 January 2017 and ends on 31 December 2027.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Charter operates for a defined period; review and amendment activity is constrained by the Charter's term dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of Government mid-term review
rubrics_metrics.description: The Government will carry out a mid-term review of the Charter, focussing on governance and regulatory arrangements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This mid-term review is explicitly not a full Charter Review and so will not look at the BBC’s mission, purpose or the method by which it is funded. The scope of review is therefore limited to governance/regulatory arrangements only.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agreement provides further detail on funding and regulatory duties
rubrics_metrics.description: The Agreement between the Secretary of State for Culture, Media and Sport and the BBC sits alongside the Charter. It provides further detail on many of the topics outlined in the Charter including the BBC's funding and its regulatory duties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational and contractual details that supplement the Charter (for example funding mechanisms and regulatory responsibilities) are set out in the Agreement rather than the Charter itself.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agreement duration and amendment rule
rubrics_metrics.description: The Agreement runs coterminous to the Charter but can be amended during the Charter period subject to the agreement of the Secretary of State and the BBC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although the Agreement normally aligns with the Charter term, it is modifiable during the Charter period if both the Secretary of State and the BBC agree to amendments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Duty to maintain and publish List of UK Public Services
rubrics_metrics.description: As part the Agreement with the Secretary of State the BBC must maintain and publish a list of UK Public Services setting out the name of the service, the type of service and a brief description of the service.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The BBC is required to keep an up-to-date public list (with name, service type, and brief description) of services designated as UK Public Services; the page links to the updated list (updated 12 September 2025).
